name: io.github.udondan/lanis
title: Lanis (Schulportal Hessen)
description: Unofficial read-only access to Schulportal Hessen: substitutions, timetable, calendar, messages

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_SCHOOL_ID
environmentVariables.description: School ID. Either this or LANIS_SCHOOL_NAME and LANIS_SCHOOL_CITY.

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_SCHOOL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: School name, together with LANIS_SCHOOL_CITY, instead of LANIS_SCHOOL_ID.

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_SCHOOL_CITY
environmentVariables.description: City of the school, together with LANIS_SCHOOL_NAME.

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Lanis username. Needed unless LANIS_SESSION_ID is set.

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Lanis password. Needed unless LANIS_SESSION_ID is set.

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Session cookie instead of username and password, with LANIS_SCHOOL_ID.

environmentVariables.name: LANIS_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory that keeps the session in session.json, so a restart needs no new login.
